question: Which of the following characteristics of the Volhard method used in precipitation assessments is CERTAIN ?:

options.opa: A solution of Fe (II) is used as an indicator of the final point.
options.opb: The titration should be carried out at alkaline pH so that precipitation of the indicator occurs as hydrous oxide.
options.opc: In the indirect evaluation of chloride ion by this method, an excess of standard silver nitrate is added and that which does not react is titrated with a thiocyanate standard solution.
options.opd: It is not useful for the titration of silver ions (Ag +).

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "The Volhard method uses a solution of Fe (II) as an indicator of the final point" -> "Certain" -> 100% CHAIN: "In the Volhard method, titration should be carried out at alkaline pH for precipitation of the indicator as hydrous oxide" -> "Certain" -> 100% CHAIN: "The Volhard method involves adding an excess of standard silver nitrate in the indirect evaluation of chloride ion" -> "Certain" -> 100% CHAIN: "In the Volhard method, unreacted silver nitrate is titrated with a thiocyanate standard solution" -> "Certain" -> 100% CHAIN: "The Volhard method is not useful for the titration of silver ions (Ag +)" -> "Certain" -> 100%
